Definition: middle voice from G1909 and G1746; to invest upon oneself:--be clothed upon.
BiblicalUsage: Ependyomai means to be clothed upon — put on over what is already there. Paul groans, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
TheologicalSignificance: The groaning is honest and the longing is right, I hold: we are not meant to be unclothed, but clothed upon with something better.
